operating_promise: Every eligible review packet contains all required source observations inside their approved thresholds when the decision is evaluated
numerator_definition: Eligible decision opportunities with every required observation inside its threshold
denominator_definition: All eligible temporary-hours decision opportunities evaluated in the window
maturity_rule: Include at evaluation time; missing required timestamps remain unknown
required_sources: facility identity; governed public hours; triggering condition; affected operating window
source_freshness_rule: Each source uses its own approved threshold; pipeline refresh time is not source freshness
unknown_rule: Unknown remains visible and is treated as bad in this fictional exercise
measurement_coverage_rule: Observed eligible opportunities divided by all eligible opportunities
duplicate_rule: One business decision opportunity per correlation_ref
retry_rule: Retries do not create new denominator entries
planned_maintenance_rule: Exclude only if the predeclared policy preserved the promised behavior
late_arrival_rule: Retain original cutoff result and process approved late evidence separately
restatement_rule: Publish original result and restated result with reason and count
error_budget_definition: Allowed bad or unknown opportunities under the fictional target
warning_rule: Warn when projected burn exceeds the approved early-warning rule
stop_policy: Stop automated recommendation routing when a required high-consequence source is stale or unknown
reenable_evidence: Fresh source packet; corrected telemetry; owner approval; successful dry run
notes: Fictional design row only; the target is not a benchmark or service commitment

operating_promise: Every in-scope case due for completion reaches an approved terminal operating state within its consequence-specific objective
numerator_definition: Cases due during the window that reached an allowed terminal state within the objective
denominator_definition: All in-scope cases whose completion deadline matured during the window
maturity_rule: Include when the consequence-specific completion deadline has passed
required_sources: authorized decision; workflow state history; terminal-state evidence
source_freshness_rule: Required decision and state records must be current at terminal evaluation
unknown_rule: Unknown remains visible and is treated as bad in this fictional exercise
measurement_coverage_rule: Cases with complete state history divided by all mature cases
retry_rule: A retry remains within the original case and deadline
planned_maintenance_rule: Exclude only a predeclared cancellation that preserved the promised behavior
late_arrival_rule: Late terminal evidence creates a restatement and does not erase the original miss
restatement_rule: Publish original and restated numerator denominator and reason
error_budget_definition: Allowed mature cases missing the completion objective under the fictional target
warning_rule: Warn when short-window burn predicts exhaustion before the long window closes
stop_policy: Pause expansion when the completion budget is exhausted; high-consequence abandonment stops immediately
reenable_evidence: Backlog disposition; owner assignment; dry-run completion; evidence review
notes: Fictional design row only; queue acceptance email sent and API 200 are not terminal states

operating_promise: Every consequential publish command due for verification matches the authorized intended state in the governing public readback
numerator_definition: Mature consequential commands whose fresh governing readback matched the intended authorized state within the objective
denominator_definition: All in-scope consequential commands whose reconciliation deadline passed
maturity_rule: Include only after the declared reconciliation deadline; retain commands that cross a reporting cutoff
required_sources: authorized command; provider receipt; governing public readback
source_freshness_rule: The readback must be observed after the command and inside its approved verification freshness interval
unknown_rule: Unknown remains visible and is treated as bad in this fictional exercise
measurement_coverage_rule: Commands with complete readback evidence divided by all mature commands
duplicate_rule: Business idempotency key defines one intended side effect
retry_rule: A provider retry cannot create a second intended outcome
planned_maintenance_rule: Planned provider maintenance is excluded only when the promised public state remains correct
late_arrival_rule: Late readback evidence produces a restatement with observation and processing times
restatement_rule: Preserve accepted_not_verified and the original reporting cutoff
error_budget_definition: Allowed mature commands not reconciled under the fictional target
warning_rule: Warn on any mismatch and on projected aggregate budget exhaustion
stop_policy: Open an exception on mismatch; block duplicate side effects; stop on a high-consequence wrong state
reenable_evidence: Correct governing readback; duplicate check; exception closure; owner approval
notes: Fictional design row only; provider success is not reconciliation

operating_promise: Every in-scope exception due in the window is acknowledged contained owned restored or safely limited reconciled and closed within its declared clocks
numerator_definition: Exceptions due during the window that reached an approved recovered or safely limited state within every applicable clock
denominator_definition: All in-scope exceptions whose applicable recovery deadlines matured during the window
maturity_rule: Evaluate acknowledgment containment restoration reconciliation and closure clocks separately
required_sources: exception event; owner assignment; containment evidence; restore or rollback evidence; governing readback; closure record
source_freshness_rule: Each recovery record must be observed inside its applicable clock; stale closure evidence is unknown
unknown_rule: Unknown remains visible and is treated as bad in this fictional exercise
measurement_coverage_rule: Exceptions with complete recovery evidence divided by all mature exceptions
duplicate_rule: One recovery case per original exception correlation_ref
retry_rule: Retries append attempts without resetting the original clocks
planned_maintenance_rule: Planned work does not exclude an exception unless predeclared policy preserved the promised behavior
late_arrival_rule: Late recovery evidence can restate the result but cannot erase the original missed clock
restatement_rule: Publish every clock and both original and restated states
error_budget_definition: Allowed recovery misses under the fictional target; consequence floors can be zero
warning_rule: Warn immediately on missed acknowledgment or containment and on projected budget exhaustion
stop_policy: Stop the affected automation on an uncontained high-consequence exception regardless of aggregate score
reenable_evidence: Containment proof; reconciled safe state; root-cause disposition; approved restart test
notes: Fictional design row only; acknowledgment alone is not recovery
